reviews.text: I would like to say a big thank you to Maureen Murphy and her receptionist, Anita, for their kindness, care and professionalism. They were both welcoming, patient and supportive, and made us feel that our pet was in good hands. Maureen was caring and reassuring, while Anita was lovely and helpful throughout. It means a lot to have people who genuinely care about animals and their owners. I really appreciate their support and would happily recommend them to other pet owners.
Dr. Maureen Murphy was great! Brought my cat in for a checkup and Dr. Murphy was gentle and caring with her the whole time. Highly recommend for a local, independent vet who really cares.
The team was incredibly kind and supportive during a really tough moment. And I felt cared for from start to finish.

I lack the words to describe how sad and heartbroken I am that I took my cat here for his final days, I will provide more information when I can but I would advise anyone to strongly consider another vet, as  my beloved Byc likely suffered needlessly for hours here before we were told to pick him up and run him to an emergency hospital down the road where he passed away shortly after.

We still have no clarity on what exactly the owner Maureen and her terrible, unempathetic team, did for the 5+  he was with them before they told us they couldn’t do imaging and we needed to urgently physically run him down the road while he was suffering and ultimately dying.

It’s one of my BIGGEST REGRETS in life that I took my beloved pet here for his final days, thinking I was helping him when I sadly probably prolonged his stress and suffering due to Hoxton vet’s lack of care and communication over the course of 3 different appointments where we shared our concerns.

I’ll live with the guilt of Byc’s needless suffering forever and the regret that I trusted Hoxton vet. I’d strongly advise others to find a practice that is professional, well staffed, honest and communicative to avoid the same tragedy.

I honestly can’t recommend Maureen and the team at Hoxton Vets highly enough.

I brought my cat to see Maureen after what had been an incredibly worrying and stressful few days. From the moment I arrived, I felt that we were in such good hands. Maureen was warm, calm, incredibly thorough and professional, and took the time to really listen to everything that had happened rather than simply looking at the results in front of her.

What I appreciated most was how attentive and considered her approach was. She explained everything clearly, talked me through what she was thinking and why, and made sure we properly investigated what was going on with Donny. At no point did I feel rushed or dismissed, and after arriving feeling extremely anxious, I left feeling reassured and so much more at ease.

The whole team were wonderful, genuinely caring, kind and professional, and it was very clear that Donny was being looked after with real compassion.

I also really value that Hoxton Vets is an independent practice. There is something very reassuring about the personal, thoughtful approach to care, you genuinely feel that decisions are being made around the individual animal in front of them. That kind of care feels increasingly important, and it’s something I really appreciate.

When your pet is unwell, having a vet you trust makes such a difference. I’m incredibly grateful to Maureen and everyone at Hoxton Vets for the care they gave Donny and for the kindness they showed me too.

An exceptional vet and a truly lovely team. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them.

In memory of our beloved Felip, whom we lost yesterday in suffering. I regret that we lost our time with him due to very poor communication from the vet / owner Maureen and 2 different front desk associates.
We still don't know what happened when he was there from 9-16:00 but this will be on their conscience.

I don’t want to blame anyone, but I need to share what happened. Our cat passed away in visible suffering, and watching his final day unfold that way was unbearable. I accept that he was old — but the way his last day went still doesn’t let go of me. I know part of the responsibility was mine, for not choosing the right doctor and the right staff for him.

I still believe every case deserves an individual approach, and that vets are people with deep empathy for animals. I share this so others can learn from it.

For anyone choosing a vet for a beloved pet, here’s what I’d pay attention to at the first visit:

• Make sure the doctor is looking for the real problem and genuinely trying to help. Every case is different, so make sure they give you a choice instead of a standard approach to treatment. Pay attention to what treatment options or tests they offer and whether they propose concrete diagnostic steps — X-ray, ultrasound, urine tests, not just blood work and guesswork.

• Whether they have enough staff on hand to actually perform procedures or imaging.

• Whether the person who admitted your pet will be the one watching over them, or if it will be someone else.

• What happens if there’s a reaction to medication or something else goes wrong — what steps they will take, and what steps you should take.

• How much time is spent on relevant topics vs. unrelated small talk.

Remember, you are the only one your pet has, and they trust you completely. We didn’t get to say goodbye peacefully, and that weighs on me deeply — he was with us for 14 years.

I hope you find people with enormous empathy and love for animals.

Our story is below…

Maureen at The Hoxton Vet was our dog Vinnie’s vet for seven years, and over that time she became someone we trusted completely with his care.

She was always thoughtful, knowledgeable and incredibly kind, but what we valued most was that we always felt Vinnie came first. As an independent vet, Maureen never made us feel that the answer was automatically another expensive test or procedure. She considered what was genuinely necessary, what was right for him and, importantly, what would give him the best quality of life.

That approach meant so much to us throughout his life, but never more so than when the time eventually came to say goodbye.

Maureen treated Vinnie with such kindness, dignity and tenderness, as though he were one of her own family. She made an incredibly difficult day as peaceful and gentle as it could possibly have been, while also looking after and supporting us through it.

When someone has cared for an animal you love for seven years, you don't forget how they made both you and them feel. We will always be grateful that Vinnie had Maureen looking after him throughout such a big part of his life, and particularly at the very end.

Maureen and the Hoxton Vet team saved a little (ex-)stray cats life!

A stray cat that was known to us, having frequented our living room for a number of years to take a nap during the day was unfortunately noted one morning to be severely injured. He’d had a horrific foul smelling wound on the side of his neck.

I frantically called round all of the local vets and Maureen is the only one who was able to see him immediately. On taking him in, she gave him the utmost attention and treated him with such gentleness, and it was very evident that his wellbeing came first. They operated on him the same evening and kept me updated along the way

I am so very grateful to her and the rest of the team for the way they looked after him - this is a photo from a few days post discharge after his emergency surgery
He is now comfortably a permanent member of the household and thriving ✨

I had an amazing experience bringing my kitten Ziggy in for a visit. Maureen was caring, professional, and thorough, and gave clear and helpful advice throughout.

I particularly appreciated the summary she sent after the appointment, with clear next steps and advice on what to do going forward. I felt my kitten was in very good hands and would definitely recommend Maureen and the team!

I couldn’t recommend them more! They helped me so much with everything I needed to travel with my dog to LA. Even after I arrived, they arranged to speak with the vet about the remaining vaccinations.

This is, hands down, the best vet around.

Maureen and her team are extremely professional, knowledgeable and caring.

We know that when we wait a bit (extremely rare), it's because they are giving the best care to an animal in need, and we would want the same for us.

The team has looked after our pets since they moved in Hoxton and we cannot ask for better care and we are extremely thankful.

Disappointing experience with the receptionist. Lack a lot of customer service skills as well as any ounce of empathy. Cancelled appointment and went to see hello vet in the same area with no problems.

I’ve been taking my cat to Hoxton Vet for several years because it’s close to our home, but based on my experiences, I would recommend looking elsewhere if you have the option.

The one consistent positive has been Dr. Maureen. She’s been wonderful with our cat, and I have nothing but good things to say about her care.

Unfortunately, my experiences with the reception team have been disappointing on several occasions. The practice often seems overbooked, and communication and scheduling have been poorly managed.

One particularly worrying experience was when a visiting vet saw my cat on a Saturday, concluded from a menace response test that he was blind, and suggested he’d probably been that way ever since I adopted him. She then advised that he needed an urgent blood pressure check, but instead of doing it during the appointment, I was told to book another visit. When I called reception, the earliest appointment they could offer was the following Thursday. For someone who had just been told their cat might be blind, the lack of urgency or empathy was very upsetting. I ended up arranging a home visit through another vet so my cat could be seen sooner.

More recently, I waited over 30 minutes past my appointment time, only to be told by reception that they had no idea when the vet would be available because an emergency surgery was taking place. I completely understand that emergencies happen and should always take priority. What was frustrating was that nobody informed me in advance or gave me any updates while I was waiting. When I finally asked, the receptionist simply said sorry and couldn’t tell me whether the wait would be another 10 minutes or another hour. They didn’t check with the vets or offer any meaningful alternatives.

When I asked about rebooking or arranging a home visit, I was offered only a few appointments early the following week that I couldn’t attend. There were no other suggestions and, once again, very little empathy for the situation. These are just two out of many such examples I'm sharing.

I appreciate that veterinary practices are busy and emergencies are unavoidable. My issue isn’t with the clinical staff or the emergency cases—it’s with the repeated lack of communication, organisation, and compassion from reception. Sadly, after several similar experiences, I no longer feel confident relying on this practice when my cat needs timely care.

Maureen and the team at The Hoxton Vet have been very helpful and supportive since day one. I'm on one of their wellness plans for the past year which has really worked well for my cat Churro. They are independent, it's relatively easy to find an appointment and they are caring, helpful, knowledgeable, kind and accommodating. I've had a very positive experience during his first check ups, vaccinations, neutering and microchipping, they have taken really good care of my boy. I am really happy with their support and highly recommend their service!

Always a pleasure to visit, very helpful and knowledgable and friendly staff, receptionists included. Ive had several mystery challenges with pets and they always helped the best they could, but equally understood their limitations and passed me onto experts when needed.

I’d give more stars if I could. Our little cats have had the kindest, finest care possible. Every single staff member deserves praise - and if vets get trophies, please give Maueeen as many as she has space for.

Hoxton vet has provided a professional and approachable service over several visits in the last few years. Compared to other vets I’ve found their costs to be fare. They make extra effort to follow up after in a thoughtful way, which is very helpful.

Not enough stars to express my gratitude and appreciation of Dr Murphy!!! My 1 year old Cavalier Theo has had a really rough week. He got a grass seed stuck deep in his ear canal and Dr Murphy came in on her day off to sedate and treat him. Then a few days later his eye wouldn't open, so had to go back. Dr Murphy was very thorough - explaining what could be causing the irritation, ruling out corneal ulcers, and talked me through the treatment plan. As a concerned dog mum I never felt rushed and I always felt like my baby was in good hands. What I was particularly appreciative of - both after his grass seed removal and after his eye examination - was Dr Murphy's aftercare. She was so responsive to my questions and followed up with a detailed email explanation of the diagnosis, how to give his medication, what to look out for, and when to bring him back if needed. It was such a thoughtful touch and gave me much needed reassurance. It's not just Dr Murphy I would recommend but also the whole team at the Hoxton Vet - she clearly attracts warm, attentive, caring, thorough and competent colleagues. So grateful that we were looked after by them. Theo has been with the Hoxton Vet since he came to me at 14 weeks and has always received this quality of care, but I think I took it for granted until this week. So grateful to Dr Murphy and her team!
I find this vet practice to be helpful and accommodating. I have been going for two years for my cat and believe they are giving her great care.
Maureen is a fantastically caring vet and consultations are very personal. As an independent business, she will never try to upsell you on treatment but will always suggest cost effective options.
Friendly and reliable vet

I've been bringing both my dog and cat here and couldn't be happier with the care they receive. The staff are warm and welcoming, and the vets are clearly knowledgeable. Everything is explained clearly, and I really appreciate that they follow up afterwards too. Highly recommend to any pet owner in the area.

I cannot recommend Hoxton Vet highly enough! I originally switched from my old vet looking for more affordable options for teeth cleaning and extractions, as well as travel certificates, and I’ve been so positively surprised.

​Last weekend, my dog Yogi had a fall. I called them immediately, and they were incredibly helpful, telling us to come right away. Because I’m on their PLUS Wellness Plan, the emergency visit didn’t cost anything extra, something that would have been a massive fee at my old practice.

​But it’s not just about the fair pricing; the care here is truly exceptional. Unlike my old vet where we saw someone different every time, Maureen provides beautiful, consistent care and genuinely knows her patients. After looking after Yogi following his fall, they even sent a lovely follow-up note to assure me he was okay.

​Yogi also just had his teeth cleaned and a few extractions done here. Again, there were zero surprises when the bill arrived, and I even received a nice discount through my plan. Most importantly, I felt completely at ease knowing Yogi was in the best possible hands. The practice has a wonderful, small-town community feel where everyone genuinely cares. All the nurses and receptionists are so lovely and welcoming. If you’re looking for a vet, look no further!

Thanks so much Maureen and the team! ❤️

The Hoxton Vet is the exact opposite of the big chain vet experience: everyone is so friendly, so nice, so caring and knowledgeable. I genuinely enjoy bringing Bella our GSD here. It's small, individual, authentic: a place where nice people help animals.
Exceptional care for our 2 cats -both of them with health conditions…finding Maureen has been a God send!! Highly recommend

Dear Maureen Murphy and the wonderful team at The Hoxton Vet,

I would like to express my deepest thanks and gratitude to you all for the incredible support, care, and compassion shown during Harvey’s illness and passing.

Even though our time with The Hoxton Vet was short, the service we received was truly outstanding from start to finish. Maureen, you are exceptional. Your care, professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail were impeccable throughout Harvey’s journey, and I will always be grateful for everything you did for him and for our family.

Every member of the team, from the reception staff to the veterinary professionals, treated Harvey with such gentleness, dignity, and kindness until the very end. During one of the hardest times of our lives, your compassion brought us comfort and reassurance that words cannot fully describe.

I especially want to thank Maureen for coming to our home and being there for Harvey in his final hours. Your presence gave me immense comfort, reassurance, and peace during such a heartbreaking moment.

I will also always be thankful that you encouraged further investigations into Harvey’s illness. Although the outcome was not what we had hoped for, having answers brought me and my family peace, understanding, and acceptance.

Thank you all from the bottom of my heart for caring for Harvey until the end and for arranging his final journey with such dignity and compassion.

Words cannot truly express how grateful I am to The Hoxton Vet team.

With heartfelt thanks and gratitude,

Kindest regards
Michelle Lara
The Hoxton vets are so lovely, so helpful and so kind! Thank you.
Thanks Rashad, we hope your fur babies are doing well!

The team at The Hoxton Vet are excellent. I have taken my cat to them for the past three years. I have total confidence in their knowledge. They have always shown great care and attention to my cat. The team are very helpful and clear when giving information and instructions. I can definitely recommend the practice.

Maureen and the team at the Hoxton Vet have been absolutely incredible.

I have been coming for a year now, with my two newly rescued cats. The team offered a judgement free environment (Lion and Chip were in a dire state), professional advices and ongoing care.

My two cats are now visibly healthier and happier. This is thank to the outstanding care they have received from the Hoxton Vet.
Good and attentive service. They answered all the questions we had and care about people’s pets

I've finally found THE BEST independent vet practice in east London - Dr Maureen and her team are incredibly friendly and efficient - with thorough and very quick communication (phone calls from the vet followed up with same day summary emails containing easy to understand info. regarding testing and treatment) - and my 12 y/o dog showed no signs of stress, was very happy in their care! Highly recommend.

Such a wonderful vet with lovely staff. We have had multiple pets registered in the past, and most recently our young cat and dog, and they receive the best treatment from Maureen and the team. We've been with chain companies before and the level of service just doesn't compare. It is clear all of the staff really love animals and put their wellbeing first. Highly recommend

Lars is amazing and super helpful! I have been so anxious about my kitten and she has been so supportive and guiding me through the process to make sure our kitten gets the best care and gets better as soon as he can! She really does care about the animals as the patients and us as the clients. Thanks so much for answering all our questions, making us feel comfortable and ensuring bow gets the best care 🙏🏼
Thank you, Natasha! :)

Such an incredible vet- Maureen has been incredible helping our dog Opie with preparation for his move to Australia. She has gone above and beyond- even coming in on her day off to sign some urgent paperwork. Highly recommend

What a great vet!  My cat developed diabetes, and I had been going to a bigger chain vet clinic.  The guidance I received was not working well. My cat was back in the clinic sick and requiring overnight care every few weeks, which is really dangerous for a diabetic.  Thankfully, a friend told me about The Hoxton Vet clinic.     She had also been taking her dog to one of the chain vet practices, coincidentally and her dog had not been getting well either.  She had been advised to go to The Hoxton Vet, where she received quite different advice, which cured her dog.  So I gave Dr. Maureen a try.  She put my cat on a different dosage, and he is doing fabulously well (still has diabetes, of course).  Has not had any sickness due to diabetes-related illnesses since.  I am particularly frustrated as the former vet misadvised me as to optimal medication, and said there would be no problem switching medication later.  Turned out switching is quite fraught with difficulties.  But Dr. Maureen spent time consulting with the vet at the company that makes the other medication to get precise information as to the safest way to make the switch and is working with me to do so.  And she has done all that consulting on her own dime, I would add.  I have to travel 45 minutes to the clinic, but I wouldn’t dream of going anywhere else!
Excellent understanding, diagnosis and care with very efficient and empathetic reception staff. Thorough and helpful follow-up.

Thank you to the entire Hoxton Vet team (especially Dr. Maureen and Lars !!) for taking such good care of our cat Artemis. They have been absolutely wonderful through and through, - kind, empathetic, and deeply caring about the pets they care for. It’s obvious in every email that they send and every interaction. We are incredibly thankful for them and would recommend anyone take their pet here :’)

Maureen and her team are incredible. I moved to her practice recently and I can’t be more safe than in her hands with my little ones. She is very knowledgeable, explains every steps and reasons for assessments and i trust her 100%.

My experience with Hoxton Vet is positive. Easy appointment booking system, pro active support staff, honest prices and of course the vet Dr. Maureen is extremely competent and genuinely cares about the welfare of her patients. I’d definitely recommend them.

Maureen has been vet to our four toy poodles for well over a decade. She has looked after them all since they were puppies and has helped us through the loss of our two eldest in recent months. She is thorough, patient and knowledgeable, but is also deeply empathetic. I trust her completely and feel so grateful to have an independent vet who is determined to resist the private equity machine. I wish more people with pets could have a Maureen
My cat has/d a rare condition and their guidance, empathy, and dedication was next to none. They also have some great new AI systems in place which are helping for insurance and aftercare purposes.
Absolutely lovely practice - always very gentle and caring with my dog

I have been taking my cat here for a couple of years and we receive excellent service. The vets and staff are kind and careful with the animals. My cat gets a thorough check and there is excellent communication about aftercare via email. Thanks so much!

Doctor Maureen and all of the staff at this practice are amazing! We’ve been with The Hoxton Vet since 2022 and have always been pleased with not just our interactions but also all of the help we’ve received for our Beagle boy Ollie. He recently had to undergo a TPLO, and doctor Maureen was extremely thorough and careful with his examination. She even referred us to an amazing hospital that completed the surgery in a safe, capable and cost-effective way. Thank you Doc and team!

I would highly recommend Hoxton Vet! Maureen and her team are super friendly and thorough! Their costs are very reasonable and we always a lovely experience when we go there, even our dog enjoys it (and all the treats he gets), I would highly recommend them.

I used to take my four babies to The Hoxton Vet when I lived nearby, and I can’t recommend them enough. Maureen, the owner, was always incredibly attentive, caring, and professional. You can truly feel how much love and dedication she has for the animals she treats.

My four babies were always very well looked after, and every visit felt calm, supportive, and full of genuine care. It means a lot to find a vet who treats your pets as if they were their own.

Thank you so much for all the love and care you gave our family during that time.

Warm regards,
The Shoreditch Monsters family ❤️

I’m incredibly grateful to the team at The Hoxton Vet for helping me obtain a same-day Australia Export Health Certificate for my dog. I was under a lot of stress with tight travel timelines, but they were calm, patient, and incredibly kind throughout the whole process. Their professionalism meant a lot to me, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone needing veterinary support for international pet travel.

I could not rate this vet practice highly enough. I wish I could give 10 stars. My Lakeland terrier is almost 17 years old (!!) and, despite having IBD and some other ailments, she is in terrific shape. People can’t believe she’s not a young dog. Maureen and her team expertly manage her overall condition and ensure she’s in top shape.  Maureen doesn’t take any short cuts. She’s whip smart, passionate, experienced, ethical and up to date on latest research and advancement. We’ve been equally impressed with the other vets on her team.  I’m really grateful to Hoxton vet. We had a dire experience with a previous vet chain that left my dog in miserable shape, hospitalised and we almost lost her. Thankfully we found the Hoxton vet who totally turned her around and highlighted many of the miss-steps the other place made.  I’m so thankful Hoxton vet stay independent and committed. Sweet 16 photo attached!

I’ve been really happy with the care given to my 18 year old cat over the several years we’ve been taking him to the Hoxton Vet. We’ve had great support with his hyperthyroidism as well as preventative care. Treatment options are always clearly explained and fairly priced. The Wellness Plan has made flea treatments and vaccines straightforward. It’s a breath of fresh air after my experience with the Medivet chain, where we saw a different vet every time we came in and were faced with unexpected costs and unnecessary treatment on a few occasions.

A fantastic team with great facilities for my darling cat!

Really friendly and will tailor their efforts to your pet's needs. I wouldn't go anywhere else 👌 have had multiple visits for various reasons and was treated well every time. Prices are also reasonable.

Although they are our registered vet, I was disappointed with the service we received. The receptionist was not accommodating or helpful and appeared to be judging me for coming as a walk-in — even though we had done the same previously without any issue.

I also later discovered that the vet working on Saturday was not an Official Veterinarian (OV), which was important for our specific requirements.

As a result, I moved my boy to another clinic, where we were welcomed and assisted professionally despite being new clients.

This experience made me lose confidence in our previous practice, especially as I had recommended them to many friends.

My review is very overdue (!) but Maureen is truly an exceptional vet, and genuinely saved our cat Weenie’s life. We had just brought Weenie home as a kitten when she fell unwell, and Maureen immediately picked up on FIP symptoms that other vets hadn’t done previously. The whole team at Hoxton Vet is always so kind and made the scary ordeal so much easier and reassuring. Thanks to her we still have a healthy happy cat two years on, and we send any new pet owners we know over to Maureen and the team!

Maureen (and Patrick and Remy) have been great with our spaniel. They've been clear with their advice, seen us at short notice when we've needed it, and taken great care of Cola. Caring, authoritative and reassuring, just what we want in a vet! He's recovering nicely from his latest mishap!
Maureen & Terri worked with great kindness & professionalism with our much loved 19year black cat , Cooper Black . Thank you

A refreshing experience. I took my boy Felipe in for a consultation and check up as he’d been having some issues with his back legs. The attention and level of care was superior to what I’ve experienced at mainstream vets, very grateful to have an excellent practice in the local area finally!

The entire team at the Hoxton Vet looked after our cat, Goldman, for the three years or so that we’ve lived in East London, and the quality of care was consistently impeccable. We sadly lost him recently, and they were incredibly supportive throughout the process, making something so horrible as pleasant as it could possibly be.

I had such a great experience with this clinic! Maureen helped me on more than one occasion, including sorting all the paperwork to bring my cat to Italy and everything went perfectly. It’s hard to find vets who genuinely care about your pet the way the team at The Hoxton Vet does. I couldn’t be happier with their service and highly recommend them! Thank you so much! ⭐️

The Hoxton Vet have provided fantastic care for my beloved cat’s ongoing liver condition. Unlike larger more corporatised practices, where I felt his issues were dismissed with quick fixes like probiotics or anti-nausea meds, and I it felt like I wasn't taken seriously, the hoxton vets carried out a thorough investigation and kept me informed throughout, were transparent and allowed me to be a part of all steps.

Every member of staff was kind, professional, and respectful, and took the time to understand me. I have complete confidence in the care my much loved cat received and would highly recommend The Hoxton Vet.
Maurine has saved our little furry family members in more than one occasion. Cannot thank you enough. She gives an empathic, personalized and honest service. Thank you.🙏 …

We brought Toffee - our Toy Poodle puppy - for her first vet visit and Maureen was gentle and thorough with her. She was very nervous having not even met many other dogs (or cats) yet and treats and kindness seemed to settle her quite quickly. I found the advice given, clear and grounded and did not feel that we were being 'up sold' on anything which isn't always the case with chain Vet practice's. Weirdly, we signed up to another local practice when we thought we were only filling in a mailing list form, and just found out they wrote to The Hoxton Vet to sign us across to them! We were a bit confused by this and intend to return to THV for Toffee's next check up and when we spay her.
Thank you :)

Maureen, Patrick and all the team here are just amazing - they saved my little dog Violet’s life after she was attacked by an XL bully dog on the Elizabeth Line. I wouldn’t want Violet to go anywhere else. I can’t thank them enough for the help they gave me after this terrible ordeal.

I moved to this vet as closer to my new home, I used to pay 30 pounds (with Goddart) for my cat flee treating prescription, literally put the cat on a scale and make the prescription, they just charged me £80 for a health check I didn’t ask for nor informed me that there would be an extra cost of 60 quid.
Needless to say I’m moving my cats to another vet today!
Had my cats for 7 years and I have never ever been charged more than 30 pounds for a prescription.
My cat needed surgery and they were great! She's healing nicely and the staff were all super friendly and timely,

Maureen was very attentive with my dog. Also very clear about all the fees and treatments available. She got me a slot as soon and possible and emailed me with lots os info and checking back on Ella.
Thank you, I was well looked after.
Maureen and her team have been so very helpful and kind with me and my dog during difficult times towards the end of his life, would totally recommend the clinic!
Best vet in the area, they look after our dog with kindness, care and professionalism. Also bonus for being independent. Highly recommend.
Absolutely lovely vet! Very generously helped me deal with a lost dog I found. I’d definitely come back with my own pet!

What a great local practice! After poor experiences at a large chain it's a relief to find a local vet I feel full confidence in. Thank you Maureen & Team

UPDATE - Second time I had to visit Hoxton Vet because my cat had an intestinal issue. She went from healthy to very sick and weak within 24 hours. The team at HV went beyond the call of duty following up regularly, even out of hours, to check on her progress and offer advice. Medical detail and treatment options were explained clearly and patiently so I felt confident about what to do. Very grateful for the exceptional care and knowledge of the team.

Took my dog Otto for a check up, the team were so friendly and inviting. They really acknowledged my dog and how nervous he was. They made him feel calm and loved. This is the first time I have ever seen his tail wag at the vet before. Thank you.
Maureen was a great help lining up initial steps for our dog’s move to Australia. Clear in her guidance and zero upselling. Impressed with the high-quality care.
Brilliant practice took amazing care of Lola x

Took my English setter Mowgli for the big snip - excellent service, follow up care and he dealt with the whole ordeal much better than expected. Very clean and highly skilled veterinarian- one of the best in London.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I can't say enough good things about my experience at this vet practice! When I first brought my puppy (Raven/female labradoodle)
I was a bit overwhelmed as a new pet owner. However, Dr. Maureen Murphy was incredibly helpful and provided me with the best advice that has shaped Raven's health and happiness. The level of care and professionalism here is outstanding! This is truly the best vet practice in East London, top notch service. I am so grateful for all their support and expertise.

Have been using this practice for a couple of years now for Molly’s regular check ups as she is an old lass.
Very friendly staff, great communication, highly recommend 😊 …
Thanks Gus!!!
Such a compassionate and wonderful team, thank you Maureen!!

Maureen is a brilliant vet and gives incredibly personal and thoughtful care to my cats. She's gone over and above to do detailed research and make recommendations for one of my cats with very complex needs. Couldn't recommend Hoxton Vet more highly

RIP Clementine (2021–2025)
Please read before trusting this vet with your pet’s life.

After my cat was attacked by a dog, I turned to this clinic expecting care and support. Instead, I watched her spiral—while the people I trusted to help stood by and did nothing. She died at just four years old. I believe if I had gone elsewhere, she’d still be alive.

Spoiler alert: They never asked how she died. Never followed up. Never cared.

As her behaviour worsened—met only with dismissive suggestions like pheromone diffusers and food changes—I eventually found her inside the washing machine, dead, after she’d consumed a large amount of dry beans. Trauma had clearly altered her behaviour. No one at this clinic took it seriously.

This clinic presents well in emergencies, but long-term care exposes serious issues.

Why I urge you to avoid this vet:
-No empathy: They do not care about you or your pet.

-Unethical billing: Took payment for services not delivered. Dodged calls for weeks. Refused refund.

-Negligent care: Refused anxiety meds despite obvious post-attack distress. When her appetite changed, I was told to “just try new food” and given a post-it with brand names.

-Manipulative responses: Cited suicide rates in their profession to deflect my complaint—utterly inappropriate and emotionally exploitative.

-No accountability: No follow-up. No resolution. No responsibility.

After Clementine died, I started reading other reviews and saw the pattern: glowing emergency care stories... followed by devastating one-star reviews from people whose pets needed real help. Mine was one of them. Read the Vet's responses to complaints to know what level of gaslighting you are in for.

I was comfortable paying a premium because I believed Clementine would receive the best possible care. She didn’t.

If your pet has complex needs, trauma, or simply deserves competent, compassionate care—go elsewhere. I wish I had.

If this helps even one person avoid what I went through, Clementine’s story will have made a difference. Please like this/thumbs post if it has helped you to make an informed decision.
